contract.difference_from_split_apple_header: Apple uses a separately guarded helper. This minimal monolithic compatibility branch refreshes the two definitions on every explicit request and adds no helper header or module map change.
contract.full_first_then_request: The outer request condition is evaluated even after the full include guard is set, so the SDK can obtain the two macros on a later include.
contract.guard_position: The handler must be outside __CLANG_FLOAT_H. Placing it before that guard is the proposed minimal layout; a handler only inside the guard would be skipped if float.h or cfloat had already been included.
contract.normal_mode_branches: Without a request, the entire old header body, including __MVS__, fallback includes, original include guard, C23 and non-strict-mode undefinition/definition branches, is byte-for-byte unchanged.
contract.repeat_requests: Every explicit request undefines both macros before defining the exact existing tokens and consuming the request. This supports repeated requests without macro redefinition warnings by construction; actual diagnostics remain untested.
contract.request_first_then_full: The partial branch does not define __CLANG_FLOAT_H or the normal FLT/DBL/LDBL macros. A later normal inclusion can therefore execute the unchanged original header body.
contract.request_path: When __need_infinity_nan is defined, undefine and define exactly INFINITY (__builtin_inff()) and NAN (__builtin_nanf("")), consume the request, and skip the normal full-header branch.

/*===---- float.h - Characteristics of floating point types ----------------===
 *
 * Part of the LLVM Project, under the Apache License v2.0 with LLVM Exceptions.

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception
 *

 */

#ifndef __CLANG_FLOAT_H
#define __CLANG_FLOAT_H

#if defined(__MVS__) && __has_include_next(<float.h>)
#include_next <float.h>
#else

/* If we're on MinGW, fall back to the system's float.h, which might have

#if (defined(__STDC_VERSION__) && __STDC_VERSION__ >= 202311L) ||              \
    !defined(__STRICT_ANSI__)
   /* C23 5.2.5.3.3p29-30 */
#  define INFINITY (__builtin_inff())
#  define NAN (__builtin_nanf(""))
   /* C23 5.2.5.3.3p32 */
#  define FLT_NORM_MAX __FLT_NORM_MAX__
#  define DBL_NORM_MAX __DBL_NORM_MAX__
#  define LDBL_NORM_MAX __LDBL_NORM_MAX__
#endif

#if defined(__GNUC__)
#   define    HUGE_VAL     __builtin_huge_val()
#   define    HUGE_VALF    __builtin_huge_valf()
#   define    HUGE_VALL    __builtin_huge_vall()
#   if defined(__has_feature) && __has_feature(modules) && defined(__has_include) && __has_include(<float.h>)
__END_DECLS
#       define __need_infinity_nan
#       include <float.h>
#       undef __need_infinity_nan
__BEGIN_DECLS
#   else
#       define    NAN          __builtin_nanf("0x7fc00000")
#   endif
#else
#   define    HUGE_VAL     1e500
#   define    HUGE_VALF    1e50f
#   define    HUGE_VALL    1e5000L
#   define    NAN          __nan()
#endif

#if !defined(__GNUC__) || !defined(__has_feature) || !__has_feature(modules) || !defined(__has_include) || !__has_include(<float.h>)
#define INFINITY    HUGE_VALF
#endif
